headline: A small reliability pass — the activity log is sturdier, and a few stale items in your to-discuss list can be linked up.

items.notice_template: I linked {wrappers_linked} of your older to-discuss items back to the work they came from, so marking one done now closes the original too. {wrappers_marked_needs_review} that were ambiguous stayed flagged for you to confirm later.

items.prompt_template: I closed a subtle writer bug that was occasionally re-introducing malformed lines into your activity log even after a recovery ran. Recovery is now a one-time fix, not a recurring chore.
When I run a repair on your activity log, you'll see a friendly summary now instead of raw output.
Recovery now carries a few small details that make your weekly audit's recap of any repair cleaner and more accurate.

Honest note: I tightened how I prepare interactive cards for you, but the very last step still goes through the older path because of a limitation outside my control. Your experience is unchanged either way — and the moment that limitation lifts, I'll switch automatically with no work on your end.
Internal tidying — nothing changes for you.
